topic: How to choose essential EMG findings
agreed_rule: Agreed: every complete-EMG control carries one required EMG finding, satisfied by one complete route: (A) a signed numerical route (muscle AND mean-relative direction AND approximate location; magnitude optional); (B) a case-specified threshold-extent route (named muscle(s) AND the reported extent or relative extent; no direction or location required); or (C) where the actual input supports it, a whole-set statement that all seven supplied muscles have displayed max |z| below the lowest supplied endpoint 3.65 (all seven muscles AND the displayed comparison; no muscle-specific direction or location). Route C is a displayed-value comparison with a pooled endpoint, not a matched LOO limit or a normality classification. The 4.61 endpoint is not a content-priority cutoff.

topic: Joint priorities, rankings and GVS-versus-ROM contrasts
agreed_rule: Agreed: case-based joint structure as recorded per row (single dominant joint; principal AND one of two close secondaries; or a collective statement). For controls Sub07 and Sub14 the collective route is anchored in the supplied GVS range, not an unanchored smallness label. Sub38 requires ankle AND knee only; the composite comparison is optional and does not establish that every joint difference is small. Pelvic GVS-versus-excursion contrast required in Sub16, controls Sub06 and Sub62. Stating which required joint is larger is optional; the reverse order is an error. No clinical-size or rank cutoff is adopted.

topic: One or two EMG findings, alternatives and mixed directions
agreed_rule: Agreed per row: OR routes and explicit muscle AND direction AND location wording for signed routes; Sub34 N04 three-route OR; ERS retained in Sub19 and Sub22 as complementary trunk-channel content; RF omitted in Sub30. These are case choices weighing body region, signed direction, information type and redundancy alongside magnitude; no universal second-item rule based on the 4.61 endpoint is adopted.

topic: Threshold coverage as a required finding
agreed_rule: Agreed: Sub24 localized GAS extent (interval about 52-79% OR coverage about 28%) is required; Sub10 and Sub13 threshold-coverage items are optional. Other threshold observations remain optional unless explicitly adopted; rounded 100% never establishes physiological duration. No universal ban on threshold findings.
Agreed: CCI remains optional throughout this 35-case batch (A001-A003 withdrawn). No automatic outside-range inclusion rule; CCI assertions remain subject to the approved correctness rules.

Agreed: no separate mandatory control GPS-like item; the value remains optional descriptive content or an explicitly defined N02 alternative (controls Sub07, Sub14). Above-median is not an importance criterion; the pooled background comparison is not a matched LOO limit.
Agreed: shared provenance/self-exclusion wording for all ten controls with separate domain-specific conditional branches; count 137 optional; G03 applied once separately.

topic: Required components, optional anchors and contextual caveats
agreed_rule: Agreed: components are route-specific; optional anchors do not become compulsory through generic component text; displayed-number comparisons (e.g. 4.6 below 4.61) are permitted while hidden-precision or clinical classification is not; no separate indeterminacy or negative disclaimer is a coverage component; small step-length phrasing is acceptable wording, not a cutoff.
